issues.title: SQL Injection Vulnerability
issues.description: String concatenation used directly in SQL queries. Attacker-controlled input can manipulate query structure (CVE class: CWE-89).
issues.recommendation: Replace with PreparedStatement and parameterized queries.

issues.title: Hardcoded Database Credentials
issues.description: Database URL, username, and password are hardcoded as static final strings in the class body.
issues.recommendation: Externalize credentials to environment variables or a secrets manager.

issues.title: God Class Anti-Pattern
issues.description: Single class handles DB access, business logic, stock management, audit logging, and email notification — violates Single Responsibility Principle.
issues.recommendation: Decompose into Service, Repository, and Notification layers.

issues.title: New DB Connection Per Request
issues.description: DriverManager.getConnection() is called on every method invocation. No connection pooling, causing excessive overhead under load.
issues.recommendation: Use a DataSource with HikariCP or equivalent connection pool.

issues.title: All Exceptions Silently Swallowed
issues.description: catch(Exception e) with only e.printStackTrace() means errors are invisible to callers. No error propagation, no alerting.
issues.recommendation: Throw typed exceptions or wrap in a domain exception; add structured logging.

issues.title: No Transaction Management
issues.description: Multiple write operations (insert order, update stock, audit log) are executed without a transaction. Partial failures leave data inconsistent.
issues.recommendation: Wrap multi-step writes in a single database transaction (@Transactional).

issues.title: Synchronous Blocking Email Send
issues.description: Email is sent synchronously inside the request thread. SMTP latency or failure directly impacts order placement response time.
issues.recommendation: Move to async event-driven notification (e.g. @Async or message queue).

issues.title: Zero Unit Test Coverage
issues.description: No unit or integration tests exist for this class. Logic cannot be safely refactored or extended.
issues.recommendation: Add JUnit 5 tests with Mockito for service logic and an in-memory DB for repository tests.

issues.title: Raw SQL Return Type Mapping
issues.description: ResultSet values are extracted with hardcoded column names and manual casting — brittle, not type-safe.
issues.recommendation: Use Spring JdbcTemplate RowMapper or JPA entity mapping.
